summary: Boundary County, ID camp (1927) with a cabin from the 1930s; staffed into the 1950s; not staffed after 1967; tower later removed, and sources disagree on whether the cabin still stands.

corrections.why: No source gives a 1930 abandonment. The register and both other sites date the end of staffing or abandonment to 1967.
The register and Firelookout.com say the cabin was built in the 1930s, after a camp was established in 1927. No source found gives 1930 exactly.

notes_for_editor: Record's '1930 built' and '1930 abandoned' are not supported; see corrections. Cabin survival conflicts: register says the cabin was left (no current date), Firelookout.com says still there, Idaho Fire Lookouts says rumored; no recent visit report or photo dated after 2006 found, so today's condition is unknown. Forest name differs: register says Idaho Panhandle National Forests; Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say Kaniksu National Forest (not resolved). Access is not established; 'hike-in' is the only access label. A NaughtyHiker page on a Russell Peak (6,830 ft, Trout Creek, Selkirk Mountains; tower gone, cabin remains) appears to be a different summit (elevation differs from 6,618 ft), so not used. The 1933 Bonners Ferry Herald item was not read directly.
